context_exception: If c sees the discarded perturbation then conditional W_m(c) can change; even post-aggregate conditioning may have a separate information path.
linear_boundary: Fixed P and fixed node-independent W_m: PZ=0 implies P(X+Z)W_m=PXW_m. Applies only with fixed context/linear aggregate/no bypass; not whole nonlinear member-dependent GNNs.
null_site: Member/receiver or member/relation bias constant within a softmax neighborhood cancels.
potential_distinction: A useful quality/storage or optimization operating point of cheap explicit edge-context correction versus projector-only private ownership; no diagnosed common structural error or gain established here.
pre_aggregation_delta: Edge-varying/private P_m can expose P-null signal if P_mZ!=0; known conditional-filter/attention operation, not new theorem or ensemble-only capacity.
single_containment: Concatenated four-state structured single with identical private gates/norm/nonlinear paths and probability-mean readout exactly equals the candidate. Exact compiled duplicate is not fitted twice.
static_factor_prior: BatchEnsemble input/output diagonal scaling; conditionalization is a known hypernetwork/filter-family composition
strongest_kernel_prior: ECC Eq1, with inherited GNN-FiLM conditional message modulation
strongest_scalar_attention_prior: GATv2-style shared-B/private-a scoring; same-operation capable multihead/branched predictor
